camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro CreateOmsMysqlDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --Type INTERNET --Username omsTestUser --Name 'oms-mysql' --Password YWJjZDEyM0Ah
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro create-oms-mysql-data-source --name oms-mysql --type INTERNET --username omsTestUser --password YWJjZDEyM0Ah --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOmsMysqlDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The name of the data source. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
The name cannot contain invalid characters such as forward slashes (/)
parameters.help_zh:
数据源名称。 长度为 2~128 个英文或中文字符，可包含数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
不可包含 “/” 等非法字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The MySQL type. Valid values: INTERNET, VPC, RDS, PolarDB, and DG
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL 类型。  
包括 INTERNET、VPC、RDS、PolarDB 和 DG
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC to which the data source belongs.
This parameter is required if Type is set to VPC
parameters.help_zh:
数据源所属 VPC ID。
如 Type 为 VPC，则该字段必填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cloud instance to which the data source belongs.
This parameter is required if Type is set to RDS, PolarDB, or DG
parameters.help_zh:
数据源云实例 ID。
如 Type 为 RDS、PolarDB、DG，则该字段必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Database Gateway instance.
This parameter is required if Type is set to DG
parameters.help_zh:
database gateway，数据库网关实例 ID。
如 Type 为 DG，则该字段必填
parameters.name: dg_database_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the data source.
This parameter is required if Type is set to INTERNET or VPC
parameters.help_zh:
数据源 IP 地址。
如 Type 为 INTERNET、VPC，则该字段必填
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The port of the data source.
This parameter is required if Type is set to INTERNET or VPC
parameters.help_zh:
数据源端口。
如 Type 为 INTERNET、VPC，则该字段必填
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.
If this parameter is specified, subsequent migration or synchronization operations are performed only on this database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。
如填写，后续迁移或同步操作，只会针对该数据库操作
parameters.name: schema

parameters.help_en: The username for the database connection
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The password for the database connection. The password must be passed in after Base64 encoding.  
For example, the value of the password abcd123@! after Base64 transform is YWJjZDEyM0Ah
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接密码（需经过 Base64 编码后传入）。  
例如，密码 abcd123@! 经过 Base64 转换后的值为 YWJjZDEyM0Ah
parameters.name: password

parameters.example: OMS  测试 MySQL 数据源
parameters.help_en:
The description of the data source.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The default value is null
parameters.help_zh:
The description of the data source.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The default value is null
parameters.name: description

EndpointId.description_en: The ID of the data source record
